events.quote: In 2025, the company paid its first-ever dividend, distributing NOK 0.90 per share to its nearly 75,000 shareholders in August.
events.summary: The company paid an initial dividend to its shareholders in August.
events.title: Initial dividend paid to shareholders

events.quote: Norwegian's acquisition of 13 previously leased Boeing 737-800 aircraft contributed to accounting gains in 2025 and recurring cost savings, further strengthening our financial position.
events.summary: Norwegian acquired previously leased Boeing aircraft, which contributed accounting gains and recurring cost savings.
events.title: Purchase of previously leased aircraft
